question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.

A person who does not believe in the institution of marriage
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Misogamist)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Misogamist"** refers to a person who does not believe in or is against the institution of marriage. (विवाह-विरोधी व्यक्ति)

 

 
• **Example:** John is a misogamist who believes that marriage is an outdated institution.

 

 

 
• It is derived from the Greek roots "misos" (hatred) and "gamos" (marriage), which together mean hatred of marriage.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Misogamist)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Nihilist **(नीहिलिस्ट): A person who believes that life is meaningless and rejects all religious and moral principles.

 

 
• **Example:** The philosopher’s nihilist perspective rejected all forms of organized belief systems.

 

 

 
• **Masochist **(स्वयं को पीड़ा में आनंद महसूस करने वाला): A person who derives pleasure, especially sexual gratification, from their own pain or humiliation.

 

 
• **Example:** His friends joked that he was a masochist for enjoying such a grueling workout routine.

 

 

 
• **Misogynist** (स्त्री-विरोधी): A person who dislikes, despises, or is strongly prejudiced against women.

 

 
• **Example:** The article criticized the author for his misogynist remarks about women in the workplace.
